reviewContext.issueReference: workflowInput issue (no GitHub URL/number): 'Port Airwindows batch 3 (109 plugins, PowerSag .. ZRegion2) into music-things-airwindows'; workflow execution opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-628
reviewContext.userProblem: Add Rust ports of the 109 Airwindows plugins on lines 221-329 of kick-airwindows-set.txt (PowerSag .. ZRegion2) to crates/airwindows as batch 3. Each port must have fixture parity against the pinned upstream C++ (airwindows b110fac3991fff7c4655cc2d25d6a3e221f9799c, MIT).
requiredOutcomes: All 109 batch-3 plugins are registered in batch3/mod.rs GROUPS and listed by catalog(); tests/catalog_batch3.rs asserts the exact name set in order.
Every batch-3 plugin has a parity test against the pinned upstream fixtures (Libm max-abs <= 1e-6) with its measured max-abs recorded.
Committed batch-3 fixtures total at most 3 MB.
The final tree passes full nextest (all features), workspace clippy -D warnings, cargo fmt --check, and the wasm32-unknown-unknown build.
nonGoals: Any change to the batch1/ or batch2/ paths, the framework files, tests/catalog.rs, the root README.md, or THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
Edits to generate.sh, driver.cpp, prelude.h, or the harness README.md.
constraints: Each listed plugin is fully ported, registered, and parity-tested. A stub, a skip, an ignored test, or a blocked plugin is a failure.
Group plans gate only on: cargo check, their own parity test, rustfmt on their own files, and the own-file clippy grep filter. Only aw-b3-15 gates on crate-wide clippy, full nextest, and wasm32.
Each plan uses its own CARGO_TARGET_DIR under tmp/airwindows-batch3/<planId>/ and sets CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Batch 3 gets a separate delta design doc so it never conflicts with the concurrent batch-2 run.
Batch 3 adds a new script, generate_batch3.sh. generate.sh hardcodes lines 1-110 and the batch1/ output directory.

R1: fixture_budget.rs now excludes batch3 from the 1.6 MB check, fixture_budget_batch3.rs caps batch3 at 3,000,000 bytes, and batch1_complete.rs now checks a prefix. Without these, full nextest cannot pass. Recorded for the operator in design-docs/user-qa/pending-airwindows-batch3.md.
catalog_batch3.rs asserts the last 109 catalog entries, which stays valid before and after batch 2 merges.
intentionalTradeoffs: Group plans gate only on their own files (cargo check, own parity test, rustfmt on owned files, own-file clippy grep), not on crate-wide clippy, to avoid the batch-1 shared-crate deadlock. A parity-test diagnostic can stay hidden while a sibling lib file has lint errors; the crate-wide clippy in aw-b3-15 catches it and routes it back to the owning plan.

R1: the one-line edits to fixture_budget.rs and batch1_complete.rs are the only writes outside the listed batch-3 paths, and they are pending operator confirmation in design-docs/user-qa/pending-airwindows-batch3.md.

Harness changes are additive: a new generate_batch3.sh instead of edits to generate.sh. A shim extension is allowed only if a batch-3 plugin fails to compile, and it must reproduce the batch-1 fixtures byte for byte.
aw-b3-00 logs any Grouping-table mismatch and aw-b3-15 corrects it, rather than the bootstrap. This has no effect because the reviewer verified that the table matches list-file lines 221-329.
supportedEdgeCases: A port that would reach 1000 lines (expected for Righteous4, PurestSquish and ToVinyl4, possibly Reverb) is split into gNN/<plugin>/mod.rs plus submodules, following batch1/g03/bigamp/.
uLawDecode and uLawEncode use the module names ulawdecode/ulawencode and the struct names ULawDecode/ULawEncode.

Dither plugins that draw rand() per sample (SpatializeDither, TapeDither, TPDFDither, TPDFWide, VinylDither and others) go through AwRand in upstream call order. reset() replays the stream from the construction seed.
Arrays above 4096 elements are Box<[T]>, allocated in the constructor. process, set_param and reset never allocate (covered by tests/no_alloc.rs).
catalog_batch3.rs checks a suffix of the catalog, so it holds both before and after batch 2 merges.
g14 holds 5 plugins (lines 325-329). Every other group holds 8.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Name mapping: name == upstream_name for all 109 batch-3 plugins. The Console8BusOut mapping belongs to batch 1.
Batch-2 fixture accounting and resolving batch-2/batch-3 merge conflicts in fixture_budget.rs and batch1_complete.rs. The operator does this at merge.
Updating totals in the root README.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. The operator does this after both batches merge.
residualFindings: impl-plans/active/airwindows-batch3-00-bootstrap.md:128 (low): the TABLE MISMATCH correction is deferred to aw-b3-15. This is moot because the table was verified against the list file.

impl-plans/active/airwindows-batch3-04-g04.md:214 (low): the own-file clippy grep can miss parity-test diagnostics while a sibling lib file has lint errors. The crate-wide clippy in aw-b3-15 catches them.
Q-R1 operator confirmation is pending (non-blocking, with a default).

acceptanceCriteria: batch3/mod.rs declares g01..g14 and lists GROUPS in order. Every gNN/mod.rs has an empty ENTRIES.
generate_batch3.sh is new and additive. It processes lines 221-329, assigns group = (line-221)/8+1, writes to batch3/gNN, and uses the same clang flags and driver as generate.sh.
All 109 harness executables build and run. tests/fixtures/batch3 holds exactly 218 files, and every .f32 is 12,096 bytes.
The R1 edits and fixture_budget_batch3.rs are in place, and fixture_budget, fixture_budget_batch3, batch1_complete, catalog and no_alloc all pass.
Any shim change is additive and reproduces the batch-1 fixtures byte for byte (diff -r is empty).
